raw_posts.name: NitroStack
raw_posts.tagline: Build, test, and deploy MCP servers in one place
raw_posts.description: NitroStack is the full-stack platform for building production-ready MCP servers and AI apps. Build with open-source TypeScript & Python SDKs, test and debug visually in NitroStack Studio, orchestrate agent workflows with NitroStack Workflow, deploy on NitroStack Cloud, and ship branded experiences with NitroStack Chat. Auth, testing, deployment and frontend stay in one workflow. Connect to ChatGPT, Claude and other AI clients. Powering 80,000+ MCP servers.

raw_posts.name: Caldera
raw_posts.tagline: Your Obsidian vault as a living profile and linked garden
raw_posts.description: Caldera turns your Obsidian vault into a public page that updates itself, and a digital garden of notes you grow in public. Plant a note and it becomes a page marked seedling, budding or evergreen, with a license you choose. Link to a note in a friend's garden and the backlink appears on theirs. Private by default: nothing leaves your vault unless you choose it, and contact details are stripped. Free, open source and self-hostable.

raw_posts.name: Notion: Context for your agents
raw_posts.tagline: Switch AI agents without re-explaining your work
raw_posts.description: Notion 3.8 turns your workspace into the shared context layer for every AI agent your team uses. Unlike chat tools that start from zero each time you switch models, Notion keeps your docs, databases, and Skills in one place any MCP agent can read and update. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP agent, plug Notion Agents into 150+ tools, sync Skills everywhere with the new Skills API, and see every agent edit in upgraded version history. Plus column permissions and rebuilt synced databases.

raw_posts.name: Emochi
raw_posts.tagline: Voice journal to understand yourself through art and science
raw_posts.description: Emochi turns your voice notes into a living, generative character that reflects your emotional world. Vent about your day, untangle a thought, or check in with yourself. Your words are transcribed instantly, helping you notice patterns in how you feel. Built by a doctor, a designer, and two AI engineers, Emochi brings affective science and playful art to private, non-clinical self-reflection. Start with a voice note. Meet your Mochi.

raw_posts.name: Train with Pasta
raw_posts.tagline: A personal trainer powered by Apple Intelligence
raw_posts.description: Pasta is a personal trainer in your pocket. Ask for "a 30 minute upper body workout", and it'll build it for you. While you train, the app uses voice as a guide, so you can focus on pushing yourself hard. It does plans too! Tell it what you're training for and it writes a plan around the days you can train. The app runs on Apple Intelligence and needs no account. Your progress and health data stays on your device. Requires an iPhone with Apple Intelligence on iOS 27.

raw_posts.name: LooGo
raw_posts.description: LooGo helps you find public restrooms instantly when you're out in the city. Built natively for Android and Wear OS using OpenStreetMap data, it gives you quick access to door codes, pricing, opening hours, and accessibility details. No ads, no tracking, and no bloat just fast offline maps and a companion Wear OS app so you can find a spot directly from your wrist.

raw_posts.name: Craft Agents
raw_posts.tagline: The world's most powerful agents, with the UX they deserve
raw_posts.description: Craft Agents is fully open source and runs locally on your machine — your data and keys never leave it. Bring any AI provider: Claude, GPT, Gemini, or local models. Agents connect to your real tools (MCP, APIs, local files) and act across all of them. Code diffs, data tables, diagrams, and live previews render inline. Turn results into persistent Pages, teach reusable Skills, and run Automations on a schedule — all in a desktop UX you can actually live in.

raw_posts.name: GPU Terminal by Context.dev
raw_posts.tagline: Compare GPU rental prices across cloud providers
raw_posts.description: GPU cloud pricing is scattered across dozens of providers. GPU Terminal brings recent hourly rates into one dashboard. Pick your GPU, compare provider offers, explore price history, and check original sources. Open source and built by Context.dev.

raw_posts.name: Ultracite v8
raw_posts.tagline: The linter and formatter for agentic development
raw_posts.description: Agents write most of the code now. Ultracite is the linter and formatter for agentic development, a zero-config preset for Oxlint, Biome, and ESLint that keeps agent-written code consistent and type-safe. Ultracite checks every edit agents make against hundreds of strict rules in under half a second, so what reaches review is consistent, type-safe code instead of slop. Used by engineering teams at OpenAI, Vercel, Mintlify, and thousands of open source projects: ultracite.ai

raw_posts.name: Unfenced
raw_posts.tagline: Land for sale that actually borders public land
raw_posts.description: Checks ~700,000 U.S. listings every week against official public-land maps and shows the ~13,600 homes and land parcels that actually touch national forest, BLM and state land. Each one is measured from its county parcel boundary: the shared edge in feet, drawn on a map, plus how much public land is behind it, elevation, road access, flood zone and wildfire hazard. Search by ZIP or state. Free, no account needed.
